items.description: The GET DigitalHealth mashup enables a clinical trial sponsor, clinical research organization or an academic researcher/investigators to set up a study, select wearables/devices and start receiving data from study participants. Participants have to click on an invite link, sign the consent, and provide authorization for the device data to be accessed by Get DigitalHealth. The platform provides study teams the ability to export data to a spreadsheet, visualize or directly push data to clinical trial management systems such as the Medidata and OpenClinical. The mashup features insightful analytics, HIPAA compliant security, normalized, intelligent data retrieval, intergration with EHR and CTMS, and more.

This is the unofficial Android dependent on the REFUGE Restrooms AP. The app allows users to interact with the database of restrooms safe for transgender, intersex, gender nonconforming, as well as handicapped individuals. Users can search a map to view drop-pins for restroom locations nearest to their proximity. Also, the app displays short bios on the restroom so that users are informed.
